results.summary: A peakbagger ascent of the Nohokomeen Headwall states 15 mi each way (30 mi round trip, 10,003 ft), which matches the overview's 30 mi round trip, so dist_km moves from 17.7 km (11 mi, the distance to the high camp) to 24.14 km (15 mi).
results.evidence: 2021-05-22 Jack Mountain ascent, Route: Nohokomeen Headwall. Ascent Statistics 'Distance: 15 mi / 24.1 km', 'Gain on way in: 10003 ft'; Summary 'Round-Trip Distance: 30 mi / 48.3 km'; report: 'hiked the 8 miles trail' then bushwhack, 'About 10,000ft gain and 30 miles round trip'. The row's own prose puts the camp above May Creek at 11 miles from the road (8 mi trail + 3 mi bushwhack), which stays consistent with 15 mi to the summit.
